note: Copy to profile.json (git-ignored) and edit. Category ids come from role_rules.json. Remove a category from skip_categories to let those postings through to the model. Left out on purpose: 'senior' (the model judges by the years asked for), 'internship' and 'trades_technician' (kept).
locations_note: Kinds: us, remote, unknown, outside_us. 'unknown' is a place the location rules could not read ("Reframe Systems HQ"); keeping it avoids dropping US jobs by accident.
focus_note: Focus groups from role_rules.json a posting must be about. Use [] to keep every engineering role.
fit_note: How a model's reading of a posting becomes a verdict. Work in 'want' is a fit, work in 'stretch' is a stretch, anything else (mechanical, hardware_electrical, chip_design, manufacturing, non_engineering) is skipped. A posting asking for more than max_years is a stretch, for more than stretch_years a skip, and one requiring a degree above highest_degree a skip. Categories are listed in jobfilter/roles/reader.py.
skills_note: Your own tools and topics. Each is a name, a regular expression (matched ignoring case, in the title or the description) and a weight; a skill counts once however often it is mentioned. A posting's score is the sum of the weights found. It orders the Inbox within each verdict, and a fit scoring at least best_fit_score becomes a 'best fit'. List what you actually work with: heavier for what you want to do more of.
